summary: Monggar district is overwhelmingly forested, with 1757.58 km² (90.2%) of its area covered by forests. Shrubs occupy 97.25 km² (5.0%) and agricultural land 69.89 km² (3.6%), while water bodies, built‑up areas, meadows, landslides, alpine scrubs, and sandy banks together account for less than 1 % of the district. The remaining land‑use categories—non‑built up, snow, and glacier—are negligible at 0.0 %.
